Sara: Heads up — preparing artifacts for the auditor tomorrow. Two quick asks: 1) for RBAC change logs (control mapping), where's the canonical export? 2) for KMS we need key-owner proof + decrypt usage for prod in the last 90 days. Who can pull these?
Alex: We have RBAC-change-events in Splunk. Query: `index=redwood_rbac source=rbac_audit | table _time user change_type resource comment` — CSV export is straightforward. Is CSV acceptable for the auditor? :thinking_face:
Sandy: CSV + small README that maps each column to SOC2/ISO control IDs would be ideal. For KMS usage, CloudTrail has `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` events. I can export those. Path I use: `s3://redwood-audit/cloudtrail/2026/03/`
Mike: One gotcha — we rotated svc-ml-infer service account on 2026-02-20; key usage will show that principal change. Include the PR/commit so auditor can trace who approved rotation.
Sara: Good point. Please include the PR link and a short note about the approval chain. Auditor usually wants chain-of-custody for key rotations.
Alex: Note also there was a role-binding drift detection on 2026-02-11 (low severity). I can include the triage summary. It's in S3: `s3://redwood-audit/incidents/role-drift-2026-02-11/summary.md`
Sandy: I'll paste the emergency access excerpt here for quick reference (auditor likes to see the human process):
```
Emergency KMS access flow:
- Request via PagerDuty escalation channel (#sec-escalation)
- 2-person approval from `kms-admins` group
- Temporary grant via STS session with tag `emergency=true` (duration=1h)
- Audit event annotated with ticket ID and approvers
```

Auditor-Bot: Reminder — please provide at least one correlated example that ties an application request id to the CloudTrail KMS decrypt event and the RBAC change (if any). They want a correlated timeline sample.
Alex: I'll run a correlation query. Pseudo steps:
```bash
# 1) find app log by req_id
# 2) join cloudtrail events where eventName in ("Decrypt","GenerateDataKey") and resource = key-arn
# 3) join splunk rbac export on user/service-account
```
I can produce a single-row example with IDs redacted.
Mike: Also confirm master key rotation history — I recall a KMS master rotation on 2025-11-10. Need to confirm no legacy consumers. @sre-oncall? :eyes:
sre-oncall: Confirmed — master key rotated 2025-11-10. Migration completed 2026-01-05. No active services on legacy key. Migration ticket: https://tickets.redwood/KEY-1234 (contains migration checklist).
Sara: Perfect. @Alex can you drop the exports + README + PR links to `s3://redwood-audit/auditor-exports/3745009876/` and set ACL to auditor-read? Also add a short mapping file `control_map.md` that lists SOC2 control IDs -> artifacts.
Alex: Done. Uploaded: `s3://redwood-audit/auditor-exports/3745009876/{rbac_changes.csv, kms_key_usage.csv, control_map.md, rotation_pr_links.txt}` — permissions set to auditor-read. I also included a single sample correlation row in `correlation_sample.txt` (redacted request ids).
Sandy: I'll package the playbook excerpt + triage note + migration ticket reference into a single PDF and place it in the same folder.
Auditor-Bot: Received. Auditor will start verification at 14:00 UTC. Please keep replies short and upload any follow-ups to the export folder. :white_check_mark:
Sara: Thanks team — will update if auditor asks for anything more.
